system.description:
You meet your victim's gaze and speak a single word, subtly stressed so that it lands as an imperative. As long as the subject can see your eyes and hear your voice, your command carries the authority of your blood.

Meet the subject's gaze and utter one simple, easily understood word ("Stop," "Run," "Sleep," "Follow," "Silence"). The order cannot be blatantly harmful or self-destructive. Make a Mental Challenge (retest with Intimidation); the subject may retest once by spending a Willpower Trait. On a win the victim must obey directly and immediately. The command lasts no more than 10 minutes.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
